caption: The drawing depicts the upper body of a person with light skin and reddish-brown hair that is styled in waves and pulled back. The person is wearing a blue jacket with puffed sleeves and a ruffled, light gray necktie or scarf tied in a bow at the neck. The jacket has decorative gold-colored elements—possibly braids or trims—across the chest. The person is holding a dark brown book with their right hand close to their chest. The background of the drawing is plain and off-white, with no additional objects or scenery. The person's face has a serious expression, with light blue eyes and pink lips. On the bottom right corner of the drawing, there is text that reads "MARY E. HUMES" and "FED. ART PROJECT OF VA."
title: Figurehead from Bark "George"
